questions.stem: In an architect's brief, what does no es seguro que do in this sentence?

options.text: It asks the reader about the deadline
It states the deadline will certainly be met
It hedges the claim about meeting the deadline

questions.explanation: No es seguro que hedges the claim. The distractors misstate its function.
questions.hint: No es seguro que softens the claim.

questions.topic: Announcing a delay to a client
questions.stem: In an architect's brief, a client is told of a delay. Which phrase best apologises?
questions.explanation: Disculpe las molestias apologises politely. The distractors refuse, blame or cut communication.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: Saying when a shift will start
questions.learningObjective: State a shift start with desde las
questions.stem: In an architect's brief, a notice says El turno empieza desde las cuatro. What does this state?

options.text: The shift ends at four o'clock
The shift starts from four o'clock
The shift is cancelled at four

questions.explanation: Empieza desde las cuatro states the start from four. The distractors confuse start with other concepts.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: Answering how late a nurse habitually works
questions.learningObjective: State the purpose of a habitual answer
questions.stem: In an architect's brief, why does a nurse answer A que hora sueles salir with Suelo salir a las nueve? Write a model answer.

answer.exemplar: The nurse uses suelo to match the habitual question, indicating a routine finish time rather than a single occasion.

questions.explanation: Suelo matches the habitual question. The tempting idea that any tense would do misstates the agreement in aspect.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: Proposing a change in working arrangements

stimulus.body: An employee writes Quisiera compartir el puesto con un companero.

questions.stem: In an architect's brief, what is being requested?
questions.explanation: Compartir el puesto means job sharing. The distractors misread the request.
questions.hint: Compartir el puesto means share the post.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: Announcing a delay to a client
questions.stem: In an architect's brief, an email announces a delay and proposes a new date. Why is proposing a new date important?

options.misconception: confuses a new date with cancellation

options.text: It gives the client a concrete revised expectation
It blames the client for the delay
options.misconception: confuses a new date with blame
confuses a new date with cutting contact

questions.explanation: A new date gives a concrete revised expectation. The distractors misread the purpose.
questions.hint: A new date sets a revised expectation.
